description: Add S3 presigned URL generation utility and integrate it into the webhook handler so that print images sent to LINE use temporary signed URLs instead of direct S3 URLs.
steps: Run pnpm install from workspace root to update lockfile

Create a new shared utility file packages/functions/src/shared/s3.ts that: (a) imports S3Client and GetObjectCommand from @aws-sdk/client-s3, (b) imports getSignedUrl from @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner, (c) creates and exports a cached S3Client instance, (d) exports a function getPresignedUrl(bucket: string, key: string, expiresIn?: number) that generates a presigned URL with default 1-hour (3600 seconds) expiry

In packages/functions/src/webhook/handler.ts, import the new getPresignedUrl function from '../shared/s3' and export a helper function sendPrintImage(userId: string, s3Key: string) that: (a) reads BUCKET_NAME from process.env, (b) calls getPresignedUrl to generate a presigned URL for the given s3Key, (c) uses the LINE client (via getLineClient()) to call pushMessage with an image message where both originalContentUrl and previewImageUrl use the presigned URL

Add a unit test file packages/functions/src/shared/s3.test.ts that tests the getPresignedUrl function by mocking @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner's getSignedUrl and verifying it is called with correct parameters (bucket, key, expiresIn defaults to 3600)
Run pnpm typecheck to verify the code compiles without errors
Run pnpm test to verify the test passes
acceptance_criteria: packages/functions/src/shared/s3.ts exports getPresignedUrl(bucket, key, expiresIn?) function
packages/functions/src/webhook/handler.ts exports sendPrintImage(userId, s3Key) function that generates a presigned URL and sends it via LINE pushMessage as an image message
pnpm typecheck passes with no errors
pnpm build passes with no errors
verification: pnpm install (should succeed with new dependency)
pnpm test (should pass with new test)
findings: Environment required mise setup for node@20 + global pnpm@9 install (MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false needed due to gpg-agent not being available). All verification steps passed: pnpm typecheck, pnpm build, pnpm test (2 tests in s3.test.ts). Post-review fixes applied: TTL increased to 21600, error handling added to sendPrintImage, handler.test.ts added with 4 tests (6 total tests now pass). Note: handler.ts captures LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET_PARAM and LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN_PARAM as module-level constants so tests must use vi.hoisted() to set env vars before module load.
